en-US: Build 204 internal device test. Build 203 (beta.60) failed in the accepted-SDK cloud build (run 35476640882) at a Swift 6 concurrency error — OfficeDocumentEditorView.swift:1153 captured the non-escaping timeoutError autoclosure in an escaping Task closure — and was never uploaded; its tag stays frozen at the failed source. New since build 203: that single compile error is repaired with a one-line @escaping attribute; no product behavior changed. Carried over from build 202/203: the Swift 6 OutlineGroup child-keypath compile repair; the release rebuild captures the full xcodebuild log and an xcresult and uploads failure-only diagnostics; post-tool replay/checkpoint memory is bounded; the IDE discovers nested Git repositories and shows a collapsible directory change tree; Office open/save/retry is bounded (CodeBlitz error-95 toast still needs your device verification); image files open an editor from workspace previews; the GitHub app release will be a normal Latest release, not a prerelease. Validation is intentionally limited to focused checks plus one cloud App build; full UI/device acceptance is yours. No public beta or App Store production release is included.
zh-Hans: Build 204 内部真机测试。Build 203（beta.60）在 accepted-SDK 云端构建中失败（run 35476640882），错误为 Swift 6 并发检查——OfficeDocumentEditorView.swift:1153 在逃逸的 Task 闭包中捕获了非逃逸的 timeoutError autoclosure——从未上传；其标签冻结在失败来源不动。相较 Build 203 的新内容：仅以一行 @escaping 属性修复该唯一编译错误，产品行为无变化。自 Build 202/203 继承：Swift 6 OutlineGroup 子节点 keypath 编译修复；发布重建保存完整 xcodebuild 日志与 xcresult，失败时上传仅失败时的诊断产物；工具后重放／检查点内存有界；IDE 沿祖先目录发现嵌套 Git 仓库并以可折叠目录树展示变更；Office 打开／保存／重试有界（CodeBlitz error-95 toast 仍需你真机验证）；图片可从工作区预览直接进入编辑器；本版 GitHub App 发布将为正常 Latest，不是预发布。本轮验证刻意限定为聚焦检查加一次云端 App 构建；完整 UI／真机验收由你完成。本轮不含公开 Beta 或 App Store 生产发布。
